description: verify-app-tls: ingress to the API and to oauth2-proxy over TLS with the application CA. Baseline (CA separation, closed plaintext ports, plaintext HTTP to the TLS ports, listeners, diagnostic routes), scripted flows over the encrypted hops (sign-in callback, session and machine requests, authorization 403s, CSRF and ambiguous-credential refusals, session refresh through auth_request, sign-out), passive capture of both hops, session resumption, failure cases (untrusted CA, lab CA, other name, expired) per service with new versus kept-alive connections, the control nginx with verification off, and recovery by renewal; API renewal without restart and oauth2-proxy renewal by restart with sessions kept; log search. Scripted clients only; no browser.
